name: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect

exam.notes: Required exam for Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert. To earn the Expert certification you must also hold at least one of: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300), Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200), or Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500). You may sit SC-100 first, but the cert is awarded only once a prerequisite is held. Exam length is not stated on the pages fetched; 120 minutes is the usual expert-exam seat time (unverified). +30 minutes can be requested if not in preferred language. Annual renewal via free online assessment. Free practice assessment available.
